topics.title: Numbers 1 lakh tak
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aik baar, ek bazaar mein aik bechne wala tha, uske paas 50,000 saaman tha. Phir usne aur 25,000 saaman kharida. Ab uske paas total kitna saaman tha? Chalo dosto, is sawal ko hal karte hain!

## SAMJHAO
Aaj hum 1 lakh tak ke numbers aur unki place value seekhenge. Aakhir, 1 lakh ka matlab kya hai? 1 lakh ka matlab hai 100,000. Yeh number bohat bara hai aur ismein 6 digits hain.

Chalo, 6-digit numbers ko samjhte hain. Har digit ki apni jagah hoti hai, jo uski value tay karte hai. Pehli digit right se units (1s), phir tens (10s), phir hundreds (100s), phir thousands (1,000s), phir ten thousands (10,000s), aur aakhri digit hundred thousands (100,000s) hoti hai. 

Agar hum ek number 52,314 ka example lein, toh dekho kaise digits ko place value di gayi hai: 
- 4 units hai
- 1 ten hai
- 3 hundreds hain
- 2 thousands hain
- 5 ten-thousands hain

Ab, agar hum 1 lakh tak ka koi number banate hain, toh hamesha yaad rakhein ke sabse pehle hundred thousands ki place ko bharein. Jaise 100,000 ya 200,000. Par yaad rahe, hum aaj sirf 1 lakh tak ka hi dekh rahe hain.

## MISAAL
Chalo sochte hain ke agar Lahore ki population ginti karte hain. Lahore ki population 11 million hai, lekin agar hum sirf 1 lakh tak dekhein, toh hum kaise ginte hain? Socho, agar humare paas sheher mein 50,000 log hain aur un mein se 20,000 log aur aate hain, toh total population kitni hui? Acha, 50,000 + 20,000 = 70,000. Yeh ek bohat bada number hai!

## KARO
Ghar ya school mein ek mazaydar activity karo. Ek khali paper lo aur apne doston ke sath milkar 6-digit numbers banayein. Har banday ko ek number dena hai aur unki place value likhni hai. Jaise agar tumhara number 45,678 hai, toh tum likhoge: 
- 8 units
- 7 tens
- 6 hundreds
- 5 thousands
- 4 ten-thousands

Yeh activity tumhein numbers samajhne mein bohot madad karegi!

## SAWAAL
1. 1 lakh ka matlab kya hai?
2. Agar kisi number mein 3 ten thousands hain, toh wo number kya hoga?
3. Kya tum 67,543 ki place value bata sakte ho?

Hisaab Sir.

questions.q: Agar ek number hai 54321, to is ka 'thousands' place ka number kya hai?
questions.explanation: 'Thousands' place 4 hai jo ki 54321 mein chouthi position par hai.

questions.q: 60000 ko kis tarah likha jata hai?
questions.explanation: 60 hazaar ka matlab 60000 hai.

questions.q: Agar koi number hai 987654, to is mein 'lakhs' ka number kya hai?
questions.explanation: 'Lakhs' place ka number 9 hai jo ki 987654 mein pehli position par hai.

questions.q: Is number 374820 ka 'tens' place ka number kya hai?
questions.explanation: 'Tens' place ka number 2 hai jo ki 374820 mein dusri position par hai.

questions.q: 154320 ko kis tarah read kiya jata hai?
questions.explanation: 154320 ko 1 lakh 54 hazaar 320 kehte hain.

topics.title: Factors aur multiples
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kya aap ne kabhi socha hai ke aapki pasandida biryani mein kitne ingredients hain? Aur kya aap yeh jaante hain ke un ingredients ko kaise divide kiya ja sakta hai? Aaj hum Factors aur Multiples ke bare mein seekhne ja rahe hain, jo is masale ko samajhne mein madad karega!

## SAMJHAO
Factors woh numbers hain jo kisi number ko bina remainder ke divide karte hain. Misaal ke tor par, agar hum 12 ko dekhein, toh uske factors hain 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, aur 12. Matlab, yeh sab numbers 12 ko divide karte hain.

Ab baat karte hain Multiples ki. Multiple woh numbers hain jo kisi number ka product hote hain. Jaise agar hum 4 ka multiple dekhein, toh woh hote hain 4, 8, 12, 16, aur aise hi chalte hain. Har number ke infinite multiples hote hain.

Ab hum Prime aur Composite numbers ko samajhte hain. Prime number woh hota hai jis ke sirf do factors hote hain - 1 aur khud woh number. Misaal ke tor par 2, 3, 5, aur 7 prime numbers hain. Lekin composite number ke multiple factors hote hain. Jaise 4, 6, aur 8 composite numbers hain kyunki inke alawa bhi inke factors hain.

Divisibility rules bhi zaroori hain! Agar kisi number ko 2 se divide karte hain aur woh even hai, toh woh 2 se divide hota hai. Agar last digit 0 ya 5 hai, toh woh 5 se bhi divide hota hai. Yeh rules humain bhaut help dete hain numbers ko jaldi samajhne mein.

## MISAAL
Chalo bayazaar ki misaal lete hain. Aapne dekha hoga ke biryani ke liye chawal, maas, masalay, aur sabziyon ki zaroorat hoti hai. Agar aapko 4 logon ke liye biryani banani hai, toh aapko seedha sochna hoga ke har ingredient ko kitni quantity mein lena hai. Is tarah aap factors ka istemal karke har cheez ko balance kar sakte hain. 

## KARO
Ghar ya school mein aap ek simple game khel sakte hain jismein aap ke dost aur aap number likhenge. Har banda ek number choose karega aur doosron ko yeh batana hoga ke uska factors kya hain. Yeh game aapko factors aur multiples samajhne mein madad karega. Jo sabse zyada sari factors bata sake, woh jeet jayega!

## SAWAAL
1. Kya aap 24 ke factors batayenge?
2. Kya 11 prime number hai? Aur kyun?
3. 10 ke 3 multiples kya hain? 

Aap sabka shukriya! Seekhne ka maza aaya? Milte hain agle lesson mein. 
Hisaab Sir.

questions.q: 2, 3, 5, 7 in mein se kaunsa number Prime number hai?
questions.explanation: 2 ek prime number hai kyunki isko sirf 1 aur 2 se divide kiya ja sakta hai.

questions.q: 4 ka factor kya hai?
questions.explanation: 1, 2, aur 4, ye sab 4 ke factors hain.

questions.q: 15 ka composite number kaun sa hai?
questions.explanation: 21 ek composite number hai jo 15 se bada hai aur iske do ya zyada factors hain.

questions.q: 8 ko 2 se divide karne per kya milega?
questions.explanation: 8 ko 2 se divide karne per 4 milta hai.

questions.q: 6 ka divisible rule kya hai?
questions.a: Agar number 2 aur 3 se divide hota hai
questions.explanation: 6 sirf 2 aur 3 se nahi balki in dono se divide hota hai.

topics.title: Fractions operations
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aik din Student bazaar gaya aur usay dosto ke liye mithai kharidni thi. Usne dekha ke ek mithai ka dabba 3/4 kilogram hai aur doosra 2/3 kilogram. Ab sochiye, agar vo dono dabbay ko milaye, to usay kitna mithai milegi?

## SAMJHAO
Fractions, yaani ghataen, aisi hain jo humein maloom karte hain ke kisi cheez ka kitna hissa hai. Jaise agar humare paas ek pizza hai aur humne usay 4 hissoon mein kaat diya, to har hissa 1/4 pizza hoga.

Agar fractions same hain, jaise 1/3 aur 2/3, to hum unhe asani se add ya subtract kar sakte hain. Lekin agar fractions alag hain, jaise 1/4 aur 1/2, to humein unka LCM nikaalna padta hai, taake unhe behtar samajh sakein.

Multiplication ka matlab hai ke hum do fractions ko milate hain. Agar hum 1/2 ko 3/4 se multiply karte hain, to humein naya fraction milta hai. Is process ko samajhne ke liye hum sirf numerator (upar wala hissa) aur denominator (neeche wala hissa) ko multiply karte hain.

Division ka matlab hai ke hum ek fraction ko doosre se divide karte hain. Jaise agar hum 3/4 ko 1/2 se divide karte hain, to humein pehle 3/4 ka reciprocal nikaalna hoga. Reciprocal ka matlab hai ke fraction ka denominator aur numerator ko swap karna.

## MISAAL
Sochiye aapke paas ek cricket match hai. Aapne dekha ke aapka favorite player 3/5 runs bana raha hai aur doosra player 2/3 runs. Agar aap do players ke runs ko add karte hain, to aapko un dono ka total run nikalne mein madad milti hai. Ab aap jaan payenge ke un dono ne milkar kitne runs banaye.

## KARO
Ghar par aap apne dost ya bhai behan ke sath ek khana bana sakte hain. Aapko yeh dekhna hoga ke agar aapke paas 1/2 cup daal hai aur 1/3 cup taazi sabzi hai, to in dono ko milakar aap kitna khana bana sakte hain. Is tarah se aap fractions ka asan sabak seekh sakte hain!

## SAWAAL
1. Agar Student ke paas 2/5 kilogram aam hain aur 1/2 kilogram oranges hain, to dono onhe mila kar kitne fruits milenge?
2. Kya aap 3/4 ko 1/8 se multiply kar sakte hain? Mujhe aapka jawabi dekhna hai!
3. Agar aap 5/6 ko 1/3 se divide karte hain, to aapko kya milta hai? Iska reciprocal kya hoga?

Aap sab ko fractions ka padhai karna maza aya? Hamesha khush rahiye aur seekte rahiye!

Hisaab Sir.

questions.q: Agar 1/4 aur 1/4 ko jodain, to result kya hoga?
questions.explanation: 1/4 + 1/4 = 2/4 jo ke simplify karne par 1/2 hota hai.

questions.q: Agar 2/5 aur 3/5 ko jodain, to kya milega?
Agar 3/4 ko 2 se divide karein, to kya milega?
questions.explanation: Divide karne ka matlab hai 3/4 ko 2 se multiply karna, yani 3/4 × 1/2 = 3/8.

questions.q: Agar 1/3 ko 3 se multiply karein, to result kya hoga?
Agar 5/6 ko 2/3 se divide karein, to kya milega?
questions.explanation: 5/6 ÷ 2/3 ko multiply karne par get karega: 5/6 × 3/2 = 15/12 jo ke simplify karne par 5/4 banta hai.

topics.title: Decimals
topics.description: Decimal place value, fraction to decimal
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aap soch rahe hain ke agar kisi bazar mein aapka favourite khana hai biryani, aur aapko uska price hamesha yaad rah jana chahiye, toh aap kya karenge? Agar yeh price 150.75 rupay ho, toh kya aap samajhte hain ke is mein decimals ka kya role hai?

## SAMJHAO
Aaj hum decimals ke baare mein seekhenge. Decimals woh numbers hain jo poore numbers ko chhote hisson mein baantne mein madad karte hain. Jab hum 1 se lekar 10 tak ki baat karte hain, toh hum poore numbers ka istemal karte hain. Lekin jab humein chhote hisson ki zaroorat padti hai, toh hum decimals ka istemal karte hain.

Decimal numbers mein do part hote hain: whole number aur decimal part. Jaise 2.5 mein 2 whole number hai aur 5 decimal part hai. Yahan "5" ka matlab hai ke ye 10 ka ek chhota hissa hai, yaani 5/10. Isko aise samajh sakte hain ke 5/10 ka matlab hai 5 dhang se banayi gayi cheezein jo milke 1 complete item banati hain.

Ab hum fractions ko decimals mein convert karte hain. Agar humare paas fraction hai 1/2, toh isko decimal mein badalne ke liye hum bus divide karte hain: 1 ÷ 2 = 0.5. Yeh bahut asaan hai! Yani 0.5 ka matlab hai ke hum ek poora ka aadha hissa le rahe hain.

Jab hum fractions aur decimals ko samjhte hain, toh humein yeh bhi samajhna chahiye ke kis tarah se inhe use karke hum calculating kar sakte hain, jaise market mein ya school mein. Yeh ek very important skill hai jo aapko aagey chal kar zaroor madad karegi.

## MISAAL
Chalo, ek example lete hain. Suppose aap ek bazar mein jakar rickshaw ka fare dekhte hain. Rickshaw ka fare 80.25 rupay hai. Yahan 80 whole number hai aur 25 ka matlab hai ke yeh 25% ya qareeb 1/4 ka hissa hai ride ka. Aapne dekha, bina decimal ke aap yeh poora nahi samajh sakte!

## KARO
Aapke liye ek asan activity hai! Ghar par aap apne family ke saath kuch samosy ya pakoray banke unka price note karein. Har item ka price likhein aur dekhein ke kya yeh decimals mein hai ya nahi. Phir un prices ko fractions mein badalkar dekhein. Yeh aapko decimals aur fractions ko samajhne mein madad karega!

## SAWAAL
1. Agar aapka dost aapko 3/4 ka cake deta hai, toh uska decimal kya hoga?
2. 5.25 ko whole number aur decimal part mein kaise alag kareinge?
3. Agar biryani ka price 295.50 rupay hai, toh uska whole number kya hai aur kya decimal?

Hisaab Sir

questions.q: 0.75 ko kis tarah se likha jata hai as a fraction?
questions.explanation: 0.75 ko 3/4 kehlaya jata hai.

questions.q: Decimal ka pehla sthan kya hai?
questions.explanation: Decimal ka pehla sthan ek hai, jo tenths ko darshata hai.

questions.q: 0.2 ko kis fraction mein badla ja sakta hai?
questions.explanation: 0.2 ko 1/5 mein badla ja sakta hai.

questions.q: Decimal 0.9 ka ma'na kya hai?
questions.explanation: Decimal 0.9 ko 9/10 mein darshaya ja sakta hai.

questions.q: 2.35 ka sahi decimal place value kya hai?
questions.a: 2 ek hai, 3 dasa hai, 5 sau hai
questions.b: 2 dasa hai, 3 ek hai, 5 sau hai
questions.c: 2 sau hai, 3 ek hai, 5 dasa hai
questions.d: 2 ek hai, 3 sau hai, 5 dasa hai
questions.explanation: 2.35 mein 2 ek, 3 dasa, aur 5 sau darshata hai.

topics.title: Naap conversions
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Aik din Student bazaar gaya aur usne dekha ke rickshaw driver keh raha tha, "Yaar, mujhe 5 km chalana hai!" Student sochta hai, "Yeh km kya hai?" Phir usne suna ke kisi ne kaha, "Mujhe biryani mein 500 g masalay chahiye!" Ab yeh sab conversions kaise karte hain?

## SAMJHAO
Naap mein conversions samajhna bohot zaroori hai, taake hum cheezon ki lambai, wazan, aur volume ko sahi tarah se samajh saken. Aaj hum kuch basic conversions seekhenge:

Sab se pehle, kilometers se meters (km-m) ki conversion hai. 1 kilometer mein 1000 meters hote hain. Agar aap kehte hain ke mujhe 3 km chalna hai, toh aap ise is tarah se likh sakte hain: 3 km = 3 x 1000 m = 3000 m.

Ab chalte hain kilograms se grams (kg-g) ki taraf. 1 kilogram mein 1000 grams hote hain. Agar aap kehtay hain ke aapke paas 2 kg aata hai, toh aap ise likh sakte hain: 2 kg = 2 x 1000 g = 2000 g.

Ab hum litron aur millilitron ki baat karte hain. 1 liter mein 1000 milliliters hote hain. Jaise agar aap keh rahe hain, "Mujhe 1.5 L paani chahiye," toh isay aap kar sakte hain: 1.5 L = 1.5 x 1000 mL = 1500 mL.

Aur finally, baat karte hain 24-hour time ki. 24-hour time format ka matlab hai ke jise hum din mein dekhte hain, usay hum raat ke waqt bhi dekhte hain. Agar aapko kehna hai ke aapka waqt 3:00 PM hai, toh yeh 15:00 hoga is format mein.

## MISAAL
Chalo hum bazaar ka maamla lete hain. Aapko bazaar se 2 kg seb lana hai. Aap sochte hain "Yeh kitna hota hai grams mein?" Toh, aap sochenge: 2 kg = 2000 g. Jab aap 2000 g seb laate hain, toh aapko pata hota hai ke aapne bilkul sahi quantity laayi.

Agar aapne rickshaw par jana hai 5 km doori par, toh aap jaan lete hain ke yeh hota hai 5000 m. Aap yeh hamesha yaad rakhein ke jab bhi aap distances ko samajhte hain, toh ye conversions karna mein madadgar hoga.

## KARO
Ghar ya school mein ek activity karein! Apne saath ek paiman (measuring tape) aur kuch samaan le aayein. Jaise ek kaghaz, ek kitab, ya koi packaging ka samaan. Inka lambe (length) aur wazan (weight) ka naap karein. Phir inka conversion karke dekhein:

1. Kitne meters mein aayein ye cheezen?
2. Wazan ko kilograms se grams mein kaise tabdeel karna hai?

Is activity se aapko conversions mein maharat milegi!

## SAWAAL
1. Agar aapke paas 3 km hai, toh ye kitne meters hote hain?
2. Agar aapke paas 0.5 kg aata hai, toh ye kitne grams hote hain?
3. 13:30 ko 12-hour time mein kya kahenge?

Hisaab Sir

questions.q: 1 kilometer kitne meters ke barabar hota hai?
questions.explanation: 1 kilometer barabar hota hai 1000 meters ke.

questions.q: 1 kilogram kitne grams ke barabar hota hai?
questions.explanation: 1 kilogram barabar hota hai 1000 grams ke.

questions.q: 1 liter kitne milliliters ke barabar hota hai?
questions.explanation: 1 liter barabar hota hai 1000 milliliters ke.

questions.q: 12:30 pm ko 24-hour format mein kya likhenge?
questions.explanation: 12:30 pm ko 24-hour format mein 12:30 hi likhte hain.

questions.q: 18:45 ko 12-hour format mein kya likhenge?
questions.explanation: 18:45 ko 12-hour format mein 6:45 pm likhte hain.

topics.title: Geometry angles
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Bachon, kabhi aapne socha hai ke jab aap apne dost ke sath cricket kheltay hain to kuch angles kaise banate hain? Aur kabhi aapne dekha hai ke har cheez ka apna ek angle hota hai? Chalo, aaj hum Geometry ke angles ke bare mein sikhte hain!

## SAMJHAO
Geometry mein angle woh jagah hai jahan do lines milti hain. Jab hum angles ki baat karte hain, to humein protractor ki zaroorat hoti hai. Protractor aik circular ya semi-circular tool hai jo humein angles napne mein madad deta hai. Isse hum kisi bhi angle ko measure kar sakte hain.

Ab baat karte hain acute, obtuse, aur right angles ki.  
- Acute angle woh hota hai jo 0 se 90 degrees ke darmiyan hota hai. Iska matlab hai ke yeh bohat chhota aur teekha hota hai.  
- Right angle 90 degrees ka hota hai. Jab do lines ek dosre ko seedha milti hain, wahan right angle hota hai.  
- Aur obtuse angle 90 se le kar 180 degrees tak hota hai. Yeh angle zyada khula hota hai aur thoda sa ulta lagta hai.

Ye teenon angles har jagah hain - ghar, school, aur bazaar mein bhi. Inhe samajhna bohot zaroori hai kyun ke inke bina hum design aur construction nahi kar sakte.

## MISAAL
Agar aap bazaar jaate hain aur rickshaw ka kaam karte hain, to check karen ke rickshaw ka roof kaisa bana hai. Kabhi kabhi yeh right angles mein hota hai, kyunki jab driver aage badta hai to seedha jata hai. Aur jab woh turn leta hai to woh obtuse angle bana sakta hai. Is tareeqe se aap apne aas paas ke objects se angles ko identify kar sakte hain.

## KARO
Apne ghar mein ek simple activity karo!  
- Ek protractor lo aur ek paper par ek straight line draw karo.  
- Phir, is line se kuch angles banao:  
  1. Aik acute angle (0 se 90 degrees).  
  2. Aik right angle (90 degrees).  
  3. Aik obtuse angle (90 se 180 degrees).  
- Har angle ko protractor se measure karo aur likh lo ke wo kaunsa angle hai. 

Is tarah aap angles ko khud samajh sakte hain aur practice bhi kar sakte hain!

## SAWAAL
1. Acute angle kitne degrees tak hota hai?  
2. Right angle aur obtuse angle mein kya fark hai?  
3. Protractor ka kya istemal hota hai?  

Hisaab Sir

questions.q: Protractor ka istamal kis liye hota hai?
questions.a: Koji bhi angle napne ke liye
questions.d: Kisi bhi line ko khinchne ke liye
questions.explanation: Protractor ka istamal har tarah ke angles napne ke liye hota hai.

questions.q: Acute angle ki value kya hoti hai?
questions.explanation: Acute angle wo hota hai jo 90 degree se kam hota hai.

questions.q: Obtuse angle ki pehchan kya hai?
questions.a: Wo angle jo 90 degree se kam ho
questions.b: Wo angle jo 90 degree se zyada ho aur 180 degree se kam ho
questions.explanation: Obtuse angle 90 degree se zyada aur 180 degree se kam hota hai.

questions.q: Right angle ko hum kitne degree ka kahte hain?
questions.explanation: Right angle ki value 90 degree hoti hai.

questions.q: Kisi straight line ka angle kitna hoga?
questions.explanation: Straight line ka angle 180 degree hota hai.
